name: papertrade_source_wording
title: Papertrade前25名亏损者中21名累计交易量达1115亿美元
content: Lookonchain 在 X 平台发文表示，Papertrade 平台多数交易者处于亏损状态。在亏损金额最高的 25 名交易者中，21 名在计入 USDC 奖励后仍处于亏损，仅 4 名总体盈利。上述交易者累计交易量达 1115 亿美元，获得 20.6 亿枚 PAPER，占总供应量的 23.4%；领取 USDC 奖励 1161 万美元，占奖励总额的 20.6%。
original_text:
Most traders on @papertrade_xyz are losing money.
Of the top 25 biggest losers, 21 are still in the red after USDC rewards, while only 4 are profitable overall.
Together, they generated $111.5B in trading volume and earned 2.06B $PAPER (23.4% of supply).
They also claimed $11.61M in USDC rewards (20.6% of total rewards).

name: attributed_forecast
title: 摩根大通资产管理预计比特币未来10年收益率高于美股和黄金
content: 据 Matt Hougan 分享的摩根大通资产管理《2027 年长期资本市场假设》报告，比特币未来10年年化复合收益率预计为10%，高于美股大盘股的7.5%和黄金的5.5%。
original_text: Matt Hougan shared JPMorgan Asset Management’s 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions. The report forecasts Bitcoin’s compound annual return over the next 10 years at 10%, compared with 7.5% for US large-cap equities and 5.5% for gold.

title: Robinhood联创Vlad卖出90%股票
content: Robinhood 联合创始人 Vlad 卖出了90%的股票。
original_text: Robinhood co-founder Vlad sold 90% of his Class A shares, retaining his Class B shares and the associated voting control.

title: 鸣石投资关联基金亏损43%
content: 与中国量化机构鸣石投资相关的 Jupiter Research Capital 旗下基金7月以来亏损约43%。
original_text: A fund managed by Jupiter Research Capital (Asia) Ltd. lost around 43% by July 24. Jupiter has links to Shanghai Minghong Investment Co., a Chinese quant firm.
